answer.doing: Preparing food at the counter: a wooden cutting board was set out with a knife, a red sausage or carrot, a wooden spoon or chopsticks and a black cup next to the oil bottle, egg and chip bag.
answer.explanation: At 16:00 the counter held only the oil bottle, grinder, tongs, egg and chip bag. By 18:00 a cutting board with food and utensils on it had appeared, and the other items had been moved. That is meal prep. Julian is a chef who cooks a lot at home and is usually home until about 16:30, so he probably cooked before his evening shift. None of his things are in the picture, and Mara could have done it after about 17:30, so who it was is a guess.

answer.doing: Clearing away breakfast and setting up to cook: the plate of white food was taken away, and a brown egg and a green oil bottle were put out on the island. At the same time a frying pan and a pot went onto the cooktop.
answer.explanation: At 08:00 the island had a plate of white food and a few small items. At 10:00 the plate, food, orange pencil and other things were gone, and a brown egg and a green oil bottle were there instead. In the same two hours a frying pan and pot appeared on the left cooktop, and a coffee tin and bowl appeared at the sink. That points to cooking. Julian is the chef who cooks a lot at home and is usually home until about 09:30, so he is the likely person. Mara usually leaves around 08:30.

answer.doing: Probably eating a meal or having a drink at the dining table. A cup and a fork or utensil were put down and the wine glass was moved, most likely for a dinner made in the kitchen that evening.
answer.explanation: At 18:00 the table had only the usual tray, vase, bowls and wine glass. By 20:00 a white ribbed cup and a dark fork had appeared, and the wine glass had moved forward and to the right. At the same time the counter by the range showed food prep (cutting board, knife, sausage at 18:00; carrot and wooden spoon at 20:00). None of these items belongs to either person. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30, and Mara is usually home after 17:30, so it was most likely Mara.

answer.doing: Someone changed clothes on the bathroom floor. They took off or dropped clothes (two camouflage-pattern pants and a grey hooded top appeared) and picked up or moved other items: the boots went and the blanket, pants and black bag were moved around.
answer.explanation: Comparing the 14:00 and 16:00 pictures: the orange boot and white boots were gone, two camo pants and a grey hoodie appeared, and the blanket, light blue pants, glasses and black bag had moved. That looks like a clothing change. None of the items match either person's list, so who it was rests only on timing. Julian is usually home between his shifts, about 14:30 to 16:30. Mara is normally at her studio until 17:30. So it was probably Julian changing between shifts.

answer.doing: Getting breakfast or a snack ready at the island. A yogurt tub, a milk carton, a chip bag, a black colander-style basket, a green bowl and a silver bag were set out on the counter.

By 10:00 it had a yogurt tub, a milk carton, a gold chip bag, a black basket over a green bowl and a silver pouch, which looks like food being set out. Mara usually leaves around 08:30. Julian cooks a lot at home and is usually home until about 09:30, so he most likely did this before leaving. No item of his own was there to confirm it.

answer.doing: Cooking a meal at home: the egg that sat on the cooktop was taken away, and a big black stock pot, a small saucepan and a white bowl were put on the burners.
answer.explanation: At 12:00 the cooktop had the frying pan, a container, an egg-like orange sphere and a bag. By 14:00 the egg was gone and a large black pot, a saucepan and a white bowl were on the burners, so someone was cooking. The sink and island also changed in that window. Julian is the chef and does most of the cooking at home, so it was probably him, possibly on a day off. This doesn't fit his usual 09:30-14:30 restaurant hours, so I can't be certain.

answer.doing: Probably changing clothes. Someone took the dark green pants and a white top from the pile, moved the black bag with the orange handle, and left a wet orange umbrella on the floor, likely after coming in from outside.
answer.explanation: Comparing the 20:00 and 22:00 pictures: the dark green camo pants and one white top are gone, the black bag moved to the back, the rainbow sock shifted, and an orange umbrella is new. None of these items is on either person's list, so the guess comes from schedules. Julian is usually at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30, while Mara is home on weekday evenings, so it was most likely Mara. This is a probable answer, not a certain one.

answer.doing: Someone made a hot drink or a small snack and then washed up at the sink. The coffee tin went away, a mug and a washing cloth showed up, and the black thermos was set down by the sink.

By 20:00 the coffee tin was gone, a 'Grandpa' mug was in the sink, a crumpled cloth sat on the left, and the black thermos stood on the right. That points to making a drink and washing up. Julian is normally at the restaurant from about 16:30 to 23:30. Mara got home around 18:00: her red handbag appeared in the entryway then, and by 20:00 someone was working at the office desk.
